---
name: Defect in the specification or schema
about: The prose, the schema, an example, or the quality gate is wrong or inconsistent
title: "[defect] "
labels: defect
---

## Where

File and section (for example `SPECIFICATION.md` §4.2, `schema/jos.schema.json` `properties.jos`).

## What is wrong

Quote the text or schema fragment.

## Expected

What it should say, and why (link to the normative section that contradicts it, if any).

## Reproduction

A `.jos` document or a validator command that shows the problem.
